annotation.title_clean: UN Regulation No 157 – Uniform provisions concerning the approval of vehicles with regards to Automated Lane Keeping Systems [2021/389]
annotation.title_en: UN Regulation No 157 – Uniform provisions concerning the approval of vehicles with regards to Automated Lane Keeping Systems [2021/389]
annotation.authors_or_issuer: UN/ECE (UNECE WP.29), published in the Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 82/75
annotation.summary_en: UN Regulation No 157, as published in the EU Official Journal, sets uniform type-approval provisions for Automated Lane Keeping Systems in M1 passenger cars up to 60 km/h. It covers system safety, fail-safe response, transition demands, driver monitoring, data recording (DSSAD), cybersecurity, and manufacturer safety audits and testing.
key_provisions_or_claims: Type approval of M1 vehicles with ALKS, limited to 60 km/h on roads with physical separation and no pedestrians or cyclists
Activated system must manage all situations, avoid foreseeable and preventable collisions, and perform a minimum risk manoeuvre if the driver does not take over
Driver availability monitoring, transition demand escalation and override rules
Mandatory DSSAD recording of activation, transitions, emergency manoeuvres and failures
Compliance with UN R155 (cybersecurity) and R156 (software updates); safety management audit and incident reporting to authorities
